t: A palm-size ESP32 controller with a color screen that powers mBot2.
steps: Find CyberPi from a Makeblock seller and confirm the kit contents.
Ask IT to install mBlock 5 or approve the browser version.
Connect the CyberPi over USB or Bluetooth.
Upload a first program that uses the screen.
Test the sensors one at a time.
Decide whether students need Makeblock accounts. Accounts are optional.
Turn on Wi-Fi features only after a privacy check.
